facts.summary: Modest single-agent responses, AML trial not pursued further · Phase 1 · RTX-240 in advanced solid tumors and AML · not yet approved
facts.indication: advanced solid tumors (NSCLC, RCC, anal cancer, uveal melanoma) and relapsed/refractory AML

evidence.summary: disease control was observed in 10 patients (1 partial response, 2 unconfirmed partial responses and 7 with stable disease), 9 of whom had experienced disease progression on prior anti-PD-1/anti-PD-L1 therapy.
evidence.safety: RTX-240 has been shown to have been generally well tolerated with no treatment-related or investigator-identified immune-related Grade 3/4 adverse events (AEs) and no dose-limiting toxicities.
evidence.program_discontinued: to focus our resources on advancing RTX-240 in combination with pembrolizumab in NSCLC and RCC, we do not plan to pursue a separate clinical trial in AML in the near-term.
